The effect is that voting power tracks real contribution, so a flood of accounts cannot outvote a smaller set of genuinely established participants.. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. Consider a tide as the anchor of the cost.
